issues.on_page: General Fund departments schedule: Cemetery column 187,954; statement p7 prints the General Fund's 187,954 as 'Public works'
issues.issue: Cemetery spending is put in streets/highways to tie to the statement's 'Public works' line. The category rules put cemetery under health/welfare. The same choice puts the whole disbursements[2] 'Public works' 736,839 (General Fund cemetery 187,954 + Street Fund 548,885, per the p7-8 fund columns) in streets/highways. Defensible, but a judgment call for the user.

issues.extracted: Capital outlay (Police 56,374; also detail[69] Fire 15,229, Golf 10,000 p18, Keno 13,976 p21)
issues.issue: User capital outlay rule (2026-10-26): capital outlay lines inside a department/function are labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (e.g. 'Capital Outlay: Public Safety'), with printed text in printed_label and function in computed. The category is correct (capital outlay), but the labels weren't converted.

issues.extracted: computed: 'Beginning fund balances, Total Governmental Funds, Sept 30 2024 ...'
issues.issue: The value is printed as-is on p8, so it doesn't need a computed marker; harmless but may confuse review.

issues.on_page: Nonoperating 'Grant income' 10,000; Statement of Activities p3 shows it as Capital Grants and Contributions; cash flow p14 lists it as 'Grant proceeds' under capital and related financing
issues.issue: A capital grant could be treated as business_type.other_financing (capital contribution) rather than an operating receipt. The grantor isn't printed. Judgment call; review is already set.
